changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwFacility AS SELECT f.id, f.name, f.type, f.code, f.registration_date, f.email_address, f.phone1, f.phone2, f.fax, f.address_id, f.default_currency, f.is_active, f.time_zone, f.working_days, f.created_date, f.created_by, f.last_modified_by, f.last_modified_date, f.rule_id, f.default_lab_department_id, f.default_rad_department_id FROM public.facility f;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwFacility TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwFacility FROM report_user;
